title: Generated Record Codecs With Round-Trip Laws and a First-Open Speed Floor
description: Make saved-data mismatches and slow paths visible in seconds (wave-4 worker feedback, ticket 26/11/13 FLEET-ONE-MACHINE-SHARED-HOT-CACHE-AND-REMOTE-EXECUTION, wave-1127/proposal-review-worker-speedups-4.md). (1) Generate both sides (writer and reader) of each persisted data format from one schema declaration, plus a round-trip law test (save -> load -> equal) per format; start with the format behind the most recent save/load mismatch (host-capacity grant record: row + .stats + .format sidecars, writer/reader skew 2026-11-28, H110). (2) A speed floor benchmark: a real plugin's first open measured against a declared minimum speed, run in CI, reusing `repo bench`, so an unoptimised slow path cannot pass for a broken feature. Done = one format generated from its declaration with a passing round-trip law, and the first-open benchmark wired with a floor; written up in the ticket folder.
